title: Characterizing higher-dimensional Hölder domains via spherical geometric functions
summary: In this paper we characterize the regularity of a domain in terms of the behavior of a certain spherical function. More precisely, given two domains we show that a certain spherical spectral function (first defined in \cite{FTV23}, see also \cite{AKN21}) has Hölder decay if and only if the domains are complementary and separated by a $C^{1,β}$-manifold. This extends the analysis in \cite{Ca24} to dimensions $\geq 3$ and in \cite{FTV23, CTV25} to regularity above the continuous threshold.
